exposure: sequential intrathecal injection of fentanyl and hyperbaric bupivacaine
premixed intrathecal injection of fentanyl and hyperbaric bupivacaine
outcome: Analgesic effect (postoperative pain scores, time to first analgesic request)
finding: Sequential intrathecal injection of fentanyl and hyperbaric bupivacaine provided better blood pressure stability and longer duration of analgesia compared to the premixed injection technique in women undergoing elective cesarean section.
